sections.title: Invoice for time, materials, or fixed milestones
sections.body: Service firms rarely use a single billing method. You might charge a fixed fee for a specific deliverable, while billing another client strictly for time and materials. Paper & Pen allows you to structure your invoices to match the engagement. Add custom line items to detail the hours worked and your hourly rate, or list fixed project milestones. While our software does not include built-in time tracking or project management tools, it provides the exact financial documents you need to turn your external timesheets into payable invoices at the end of the month.
items: Send via email or WhatsApp link
Track unpaid client invoices with ease

sections.title: Manage retainers and work in progress accurately
sections.body: When clients pay a retainer upfront, that money is not yet earned revenue. It is a liability held against future work. Our general ledger lets you post manual journal entries to account for client deposits correctly. As your team completes the work, you can recognise the earned revenue and draw down the retainer balance. You can also account for work in progress that is earned but not yet billed, ensuring your balance sheet reflects the true financial position of your firm before the monthly billing cycle concludes.
items: Record client retainers as firm liabilities
Draw down balances with journal entries
Account for unbilled work in progress

sections.title: Recover client disbursements at cost
sections.body: Lawyers, consultants, and agencies frequently incur costs on behalf of their clients. Whether these are travel expenses, filing fees, or third-party vendor costs, you need a reliable way to recover these disbursements. Log every out-of-pocket cost in the expenses module as soon as it occurs. When your monthly billing cycle arrives, you can review these logged expenses and add them to the client's invoice. This ensures you recover disbursements at cost without letting small expenses slip through the cracks and erode your firm's profit margins.
items: Categorise costs by client or project

faqs.q: Does Paper & Pen include time tracking for my staff?
faqs.a: No, Paper & Pen focuses strictly on accounting and invoicing. We do not offer built-in time tracking, timesheets, or project management features. You will need to track your billable hours in a separate tool, and then use our software to generate the final invoices, log disbursements, and manage the general ledger.

faqs.q: How do I handle client retainers in the software?
faqs.a: You can manage retainers using our general ledger. When a client pays a deposit, you post a journal entry to record the cash and create a liability account for the unearned retainer. Once you complete the work and issue an invoice, you post another journal entry to move the funds from the liability account to earned revenue.

faqs.q: Can I bill for both fixed fees and hourly work?
faqs.a: Yes. Your invoices are completely customisable to fit your specific engagement contracts. You can create line items for fixed fee milestones, and add separate line items on the exact same invoice to bill for time and materials. Just enter the number of hours in the quantity field and your hourly rate in the price field. This flexibility supports complex professional services billing.

faqs.q: How do I account for work in progress that is not yet billed?
faqs.a: Work in progress represents services you have performed but have not yet invoiced to the client. To keep your financial statements accurate before the monthly billing cycle, you can use the manual journal entry feature. This allows you to recognise the accrued revenue and the corresponding unbilled receivables asset on your balance sheet until the actual invoice is generated.
